description: The basket for a theme/subtheme (or a CUSTOM theme the user typed) in the chosen asset class: equal-weight top assets by the model's relevance, vetted live, with provenance and caveat. With create=true (signed-in user) it becomes the user's own vehicle — an event card (default) or an AI Index Basket — paid with the user's own balance. (no key needed)

conversation_id.description: conversation_id returned by an earlier theme_journey_* call (keeps an anonymous visitor's interests and basket together until they register).

theme.description: theme/subtheme slug or label, or the user's own custom theme text

name: theme_journey_basket
title: Theme Journey Basket
